partSemantics.policy: An explicit building:part=no envelope uses valid linked parts when they reach the measured total height, or an exact lattice source note explicitly directs their rendering. Reviewed source-specific exceptions require their recorded source tags and complete named part set. Ordinary incompletely mapped outlines retain their fallback. No geometry is invented.

partsOnlyOutlines.reason: Reviewed Mont Saint-Michel church envelope: its 78.5 m height describes the spire; 17 mapped church parts include the 79 m spire and the lower gabled roofs. The dual building/building:part tags prevent ordinary parent association. Preserve the source footprint in plan and use these actual parts in 3D.
